entities.name: Tyson R. Roberts

entities.summary: Tyson Royal Roberts was an American ichthyologist. He was described as "the world's foremost authority on Regalecus". He died on June 20, 2025 at the Nakhon Pathom Hospital in Nakhon Pathom, Thailand.
